verdict.rationale: Netlify's own materials state it auto-deploys on every push, with a preview URL for every PR. Independent community users confirm that the GitHub integration's automated builds and deploys, including PR preview builds, work well in practice. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of Git provider connection and branch/build configuration, evidence of support for Git hosts beyond GitHub.

support.subject: As a developer, I can automatically deploy my app on every Git push

citations.quote: Auto-deploy on every push. Every PR gets a preview URL.
The GitHub/Slack integration, automated builds and deploys, and rewrites/reverse proxy support work great.
The real killer bit for me has been their GitHub integration where they render a preview build of any PRs.
